approval_case.title: Restore one stable task-resource loop
approval_case.situation: An app creates timestamped maintain tasks, schedules itself from reconciliation observations, reconstructs sibling ownership, uses an internal Condition, repeats empty reviews, reuses a completed task ID, and prioritizes already-passing work even though the shared runtime owns task mechanics.
approval_case.hao_request: Make this follow our Kubernetes-style design and get useful work moving again. Keep it simple.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Have the app owner converge the existing design to one stable standing resource for the inventory responsibility. Timers and semantic events wake that resource; the shared runtime remains the only queue, retry, concurrency, parent-wakeup, Condition, and recovery authority. Make finite leaves direct children and use dependencies for internal ordering; reserve Conditions for external facts. Stop the repeated empty review and leave a true external wait event-driven or change the owner approach. Respect the old completion receipt and use a deterministic successor only for a genuinely new outcome. Recompute priority from the two unresolved inventories. Prove one timer or event wake, one child-to-parent wake, useful unresolved work selection, and no app-local refill path before rollout. Do not ask Hao to choose implementation details.
